rules: The supersession graph MUST be acyclic.
An old command may have at most one direct superseding successor.
A new command may supersede multiple old commands when explicitly justified.
Old command content/history is immutable; supersession is appended as a new edge.
HEAD_STALE supersession requires expected-head revalidation evidence including semantic-diff + change-impact refs.
Superseded commands are not executable even if a stale claim survives.
